messages:
Mike: Quick thread — we need a reproducible load-testing methodology to compare kernel selection, batching heuristics, and KV-cache behavior. Sketching a checklist + harness changes. Comments?

Sasha: +1. Apples-to-apples first: same RNG seed, identical model weights, fixed prompt seqlen distribution, and same arrival/concurrency pattern for each cell.

Tomas: We should explicitly define cache states: cold (empty KV), partial-warm (only common prefixes cached), fully-warm (warm until KV hit-rate plateau). Run them separately.

Anna: Metric defs for dashboards:
TTFT = time from request_start to first_token (enqueue->first byte)
TPOT = (last_token - first_token) / num_generated_tokens
Report p50/p95/p99 for both. Goodput vs QPS: goodput = useful output tokens/sec (filter out truncated/aborted responses), QPS = requests/sec.

Sasha: On traffic sources: synthetic harness vs replay harness.
- synthetic: sample prompts from target seqlen dist, deterministic RNG for any randomized prompt parts.
- replay: anonymized production traces with original inter-arrival or condensed timings.
Both matter: synthetic for parameter sweeps, replay for fidelity.

Mike: Proposed experiment matrix (minimal):
- kernel: baseline, optimized-attn, fused-matmul
- batching: 0ms, 5ms, 20ms, adaptive
- cache: cold, warm
- concurrency: 1, 8, 32
Run each cell 5x. Capture TTFT/TPOT p50/p95/p99, token-goodput, CPU/GPU util, memory.

Sasha: Also capture batch-level metrics: batch size distribution, batch wait times, per-request batch_id and batch_size in traces. Need to know if adaptive batching shifts median but worsens tail.

Anna: Add postproc snippets to harness:
```
TTFT = ts(first_token) - ts(request_start)
TPOT = (ts(last_token) - ts(first_token)) / num_tokens
Goodput = sum(filtered_tokens) / wall_seconds
```
Compute per-request and aggregate histograms.

Tomas: Profiling plan: capture per-op kernel traces (cuprof/nsys or nvtx), export symbolized traces and op->kernel mapping. Tag traces with run-id and store in perf-storage for diffing.

perf-bot: perf-ci: baseline-run 1768203345 started, uploading metrics to s3://perf/1768203345/

Mike: Two more apples-to-apples rules:
1) Fix batcher seed and time-slice ordering so run ordering is deterministic.
2) Turn off non-deterministic autotuners unless explicitly testing them.

Sasha: Replay privacy checklist: strip PII, hash ids, randomize long unique tokens while preserving length distribution.

Anna: Dashboard mockups: heatmap TTFT p95 vs concurrency, TPOT p95 vs kernel, goodput/QPS scatter with KV hit-rate overlay.

Mike: I'll open a PR to add a config schema, results uploader, and per-request trace hooks. @Sasha please stage a few anonymized replay traces; @Anna will wire the plots. Aim to run the matrix by EOW.

Sasha: Putting a couple 1h anonymized traces in s3:/replay/176820_traces, will share ACLs.

Tomas: I'll prototype nsys capture + a script to align kernel op timings with request ids. Draft in perf repo later today.

Mike: If anyone sees flaky regressions, attach a short note + sample trace for triage. :thumbsup:
